setting: Keep actual November IR, frozen original RGB encoder/head, same1152 Train frames and stats, only physical GPU2/3. No Test data or image regeneration.
hypothesis: A strong frozen RGB head can leave too little positive supervision for the added cue. Moreover, wrong-frame IR may still contain valid class1 foreground at a current object location; blanket preservation can penalize semantically valid extra evidence. These are hypotheses, not established failures or gains.

curriculum.scope: Train-only weakening of RGB FPN contrast inside selected recoverable object boxes, keeping RGB/IR source pixels and all inference code unchanged. Auxiliary input stays the original current frame. Clean samples remain.
curriculum.recoverability: Original actual IR quality>=0.15 and tolerant RGB/IR body-support overlap>=0.25 within the original Train GT box. Fixed before extraction.
curriculum.matched_control: The exact same eligible instances, degradation draws and sample order are used for RGB-repeat, gray and IR controls. This gives RGB controls privileged Train-only recovery selection; do not call them purely RGB-trained.

counterfactual_validity.rule: Within-video swapped auxiliary GT boxes provide only Train-time validity. Do not penalize a grid location where both current and swapped frames contain foreground. Continue reference preservation elsewhere; keep normalization by original teacher foreground mass.
counterfactual_validity.scope: Binary fish objectness is not fish identity; shared foreground can remain semantically valid after a frame swap. No GT reaches inference. This conservative mask does not guarantee that generated IR depicts every labeled fish.

ablation_controls: No recoverability curriculum, same validity mask
Full IR, equal-capacity RGB-repeat and gray, all3 seeds if promising
activation: Do not fit this repair before complete parent pilot Dev results. Use it only if parent IR fails to establish an advantage over the strongest matched RGB/gray control; otherwise prioritize formal seed/removal validation of the promising parent. Eligibility diagnostics may run beforehand without fitting.
novelty: Dropping a dominant modality, local attention and ordinary consistency are prior art. Credit only problem-specific, independently measured contributions beyond strong matched controls.
